description: Bulk demographic, economic, and spatial lookup for 1 to 50 Great Britain postcodes. Returns brief profile by default (~80 tokens per postcode) to prevent context blow-up; use view="full" when all 113 metrics are needed. Cost-effective for 6 to 50 postcodes ($0.050 flat fee). For 1 postcode use lookup_postcode ($0.005); for 2 to 5 postcodes use compare_postcodes ($0.010). Do not use when detailed side-by-side comparative rankings are required (use compare_postcodes).

postcodes.description: Array of 1 to 50 Great Britain postcodes to enrich. Cost-effective for 6 to 50 postcodes ($0.050 flat fee). For 1 postcode use lookup_postcode ($0.005); for 2 to 5 postcodes use compare_postcodes ($0.010).

view.description: View slice for each postcode in the batch results: "brief" (or "summary"/"ai", ~80 tokens per postcode, default for batch calls to prevent context blow-up), "full" (complete 113-metric dataset per postcode, explicitly requested when all metrics needed), "property", "demographics", "education", "healthcare", "transit", or "services".

name: enrich_postcodes

est_median_household_income_gbp.description: Heuristic neighbourhood estimate of annual median gross disposable household income in GBP (LSOA/Data Zone level) derived from a linear formula weighting DWP/HMRC income deprivation deciles, Census NS-SeC managerial occupation shares, and Level 4 qualifications, clamped at £21,000–£95,000. Not an observed Census return.

population_density_per_sqkm.description: Resident population density per square kilometre from Census 2021 small area boundaries

_scale_explanation.description: 1 = most deprived 10% nationally, 10 = least deprived 10% nationally

crime_safety_decile.description: Statutory Crime Deprivation Decile (1-10) from the English IoD 2025, Welsh WIMD 2025, and Scottish SIMD 2020 (1 = highest recorded crime deprivation nationally, 10 = lowest recorded crime deprivation / safest 10%). Sourced from multi-year police records per capita at LSOA level. Represents neighbourhood historical baseline, not individual personal victimisation risk.

broadband_speed_tier_mbps.description: Estimated fixed broadband download speed tier in Mbps (350, 120, 80, or 68.5 Mbps baseline derived from Ofcom Connected Nations availability brackets)

gigabit_availability_pct.description: Ofcom full-fibre / gigabit network coverage percentage

median_download_mbps.description: Median fixed broadband download speed in Mbps (Ofcom Connected Nations)

care_type.description: Service classification: GP Practice, Hospital, Clinic

distance_km.description: Straight-line distance in kilometers from postcode coordinates

id.description: CQC or NHS provider/location ID e.g. CQC-1-12687408410

inspection_date.description: Inspection date or last verified date

rating.description: Regulatory rating e.g. Outstanding, Good, or null if unrated/pending

regulator.description: National healthcare regulator e.g. CQC, HIS, HIW

nearest_gp_surgery.description: Nearest GP practice / general practitioner surgery

demographic_distortion_note.description: Explanation of divergence between the landmark and surrounding small-area residential census population

is_national_landmark.description: True if this postcode represents a major national landmark, royal palace, civic seat, or special non-geographic entity

landmark_category.description: Category classification of the landmark or exceptional entity

landmark_name.description: Official name of the landmark (e.g. Buckingham Palace, 10 Downing Street)

lsoa_code.description: 2021 Census Lower Layer Super Output Area code or Data Zone

msoa_code.description: 2021 Census Middle Layer Super Output Area code

outcode.description: Outward code (e.g. BB7, SW1A, EH1, CF10)

postcode.description: Standard formatted Great Britain postcode with space

region_or_nation.description: Great Britain Region or Sovereign Nation (England, Scotland, Wales)

avg_floor_area_sqm.description: Mean domestic internal floor area from Open EPC Register

dominant_property_type.description: Predominant housing typology (Detached, Semi-Detached, Terraced, Flat/Maisonette)

epc_rating_current.description: Modal current EPC energy efficiency band (A-G)

epc_rating_potential.description: Modal potential EPC energy efficiency band (A-G)

median_house_price_gbp.description: HM Land Registry (E&W 2024–2026) and Registers of Scotland (Scotland 2023–2025) 3-year rolling median transaction price in GBP

pre_1930_housing_pct.description: Percentage of domestic stock built prior to 1930

price_basis.description: Spatial resolution and temporal window metadata for the property transaction valuation

n.description: Number of recorded transactions in rolling window used to compute median price

resolution.description: Spatial granularity of the median property valuation

window.description: Rolling temporal transaction window (2024–2026 for England & Wales, 2023–2025 for Scotland)

price_per_sqm_gbp.description: Synthetic property valuation benchmark joining 3-year rolling median transaction prices (HMLR / RoS) with domestic mean internal floor areas (Open EPC / Scottish EPC Register) at postcode level

retrofit_upside_potential.description: Summary of energy efficiency retrofit potential

distance_km.description: Straight-line distance in kilometers from postcode coordinates

id.description: Unique school identifier e.g. ENG-101138, SCO-5507427, WAL-6813350

name.description: Official school name (headteachers/staff names strictly excluded)

phase.description: Educational phase: Primary, Secondary, 16 plus, All-through

religious_character.description: Religious ethos or designation, or null if secular/none

affluence_score_100.description: Composite socio-economic score from 1 to 100 (weighted: 35% modelled income, 25% human capital qualifications/NS-SeC, 25% IMD deprivation freedom, 15% homeownership equity; ~10 points represents ~1 national decile shift)

ai_context_briefing.description: Pre-synthesised dense natural language summary designed for LLM context window injection

b2c_spending_propensity.description: Inferred neighbourhood consumer expenditure profile derived from local affluence tier and tenure. Represents a macro area characteristic, not an observed financial record of an individual household.

commuter_connectivity_score_100.description: Composite multi-modal connectivity score from 1 to 100 (45% straight-line geodesic distance to nearest rail/rapid transit station, up to +15 pts strategic intercity hub bonus, 20% zero-car transit reliance density, 15% broadband speed tier & gigabit coverage, 10% affluence)

family_suitability_score_100.description: Composite family suitability score from 1 to 100 (weighted: 40% statutory crime safety decile, 30% statutory education/skills deprivation decile adjusted by -2 pts/km capped at -20 when nearest school >3km geodesic distance, 30% child and parenting-age demographic density)

property_value_index.description: Relative property valuation index benchmarked against prime central London baseline (£16,200/sqm ceiling = 100)

nearest_intercity_hub.description: Nearest primary national or regional mainline railway hub (>= 2M annual passengers or Network Rail Category A/B interchange)

distance_km.description: Straight-line distance in kilometres from postcode coordinates

hub_type.description: Station hierarchy tier based on ORR annual passenger footfall and mainline intercity connectivity

name.description: Official station name (e.g. Manchester Victoria, Westminster)

station_type.description: Transit network mode (e.g. National Rail, London Underground, DLR, Metro / Tram)

nearest_station.description: Nearest National Rail, London Underground, DLR, or light rail / tram station of any classification
